prompts.text: Fix this JavaScript function so it returns the sum of all array elements, including the last one: function sum(xs) { let n=0; for(let i=0;i<xs.length-1;i++) n+=xs[i]; return n; } Return corrected code and one brief explanation.
A box contains 4 red and 6 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that they have different colors? Give an exact fraction and a short derivation.

A service reports that average latency fell from 200 ms to 150 ms after a change, but its traffic also shifted toward smaller requests. Explain the confounder and propose one fair comparison in three concise sentences.
